speaker: Colony Breach cast
direction: Colony Breach beat narration (colony-breach-nouns.md Beats; names per swarm-lore-guide.md: the company says ravs and strain names, the militia says ravs, holes, grabbers and breakers, the administrator says the ground and whispers the bloom). CASTLE is the company officer voice; SGT. TOLLIVER is the colony militia voice (Sadie, calm gritty); ADMINISTRATOR VOSS is the colony shelter administrator (David, raspy and soft). Treatment: comms on the shelter radio. Voices are library picks; swap voiceId and regenerate with --replace.

lines.text: Company is down at the colony edge. Expect ravs. Find the shelter, survivors first.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [calm, businesslike] Company is down at the colony edge. Expect ravs. Find the shelter, survivors first.

lines.text: Marines! Over here, we're holding the line. The shelter is north of the market. Please hurry, the ravs come up out of the dark.
lines.speaker: SGT. TOLLIVER / COLONY MILITIA
lines.synthesisText: [hoarse, relieved] Marines! Over here, we're holding the line. The shelter is north of the market. Please hurry, the ravs come up out of the dark.

lines.text: You came. The doors are open, all of us are in here. It's a bloom, isn't it? Get us to the lift, we will follow your people.
lines.speaker: ADMINISTRATOR VOSS / COLONY SHELTER
lines.synthesisText: [shaky, trying to stay composed] You came. The doors are open, all of us are in here. [whispering] It's a bloom, isn't it? [shaky] Get us to the lift, we will follow your people.

lines.text: Do you feel that? The floor is moving. The ground is opening under the colony.
lines.speaker: ADMINISTRATOR VOSS / COLONY SHELTER
lines.synthesisText: [alarmed, quiet] Do you feel that? The floor is moving. The ground is opening under the colony.

lines.text: Rav contact below! The ground has opened up, grid one.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [tense, controlled] Rav contact below! The ground has opened up, grid one.

lines.text: Bore one is widening. Brutes are coming out of it.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [grim] Bore one is widening. Brutes are coming out of it.

lines.text: Bore one has become a maw. Collapse it or stay clear.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [grim, urgent] Bore one has become a maw. Collapse it or stay clear.

lines.text: Hole one is down! No more ravs out of that pit.
lines.speaker: SGT. TOLLIVER / COLONY MILITIA
lines.synthesisText: [relieved, rough] Hole one is down! No more ravs out of that pit.

lines.text: Second breach. The ground is tearing open, grid two.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [tense, controlled] Second breach. The ground is tearing open, grid two.

lines.text: Bore two is widening. Brutes now, watch your walls.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [grim] Bore two is widening. Brutes now, watch your walls.

lines.text: Bore two has become a maw. It is feeding the swarm.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [grim, urgent] Bore two has become a maw. It is feeding the swarm.

lines.text: That's two holes shut. Good work, Marines.
lines.speaker: SGT. TOLLIVER / COLONY MILITIA
lines.synthesisText: [relieved, rough] That's two holes shut. Good work, Marines.

lines.text: A third. They are coming up everywhere, grid three.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [tense, controlled] A third. They are coming up everywhere, grid three.

lines.text: Bore three is widening. It is putting out brutes.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [grim] Bore three is widening. It is putting out brutes.

lines.text: Bore three has become a maw. Do not let it grow further.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [grim, urgent] Bore three has become a maw. Do not let it grow further.

lines.text: Three down. The east side is quiet.
lines.speaker: SGT. TOLLIVER / COLONY MILITIA
lines.synthesisText: [relieved, rough] Three down. The east side is quiet.

lines.text: Fourth breach. Watch your feet, grid four.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [tense, controlled] Fourth breach. Watch your feet, grid four.

lines.text: Bore four is widening. Brutes are surfacing.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [grim] Bore four is widening. Brutes are surfacing.

lines.text: Bore four has become a maw. Hit it or avoid it.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [grim, urgent] Bore four has become a maw. Hit it or avoid it.

lines.text: Four is caved in. You are clearing them out.
lines.speaker: SGT. TOLLIVER / COLONY MILITIA
lines.synthesisText: [relieved, rough] Four is caved in. You are clearing them out.

lines.text: Marines at post two! We've got people in the back, get them out of here.
lines.speaker: SGT. TOLLIVER / COLONY MILITIA
lines.synthesisText: [breathless, relieved] Marines at post two! We've got people in the back, get them out of here.

lines.text: Marines at post three! We've got people in the back, get them out of here.
lines.speaker: SGT. TOLLIVER / COLONY MILITIA
lines.synthesisText: [breathless, relieved] Marines at post three! We've got people in the back, get them out of here.

lines.text: Marines at post four! We've got people in the back, get them out of here.
lines.speaker: SGT. TOLLIVER / COLONY MILITIA
lines.synthesisText: [breathless, relieved] Marines at post four! We've got people in the back, get them out of here.

lines.text: They're over the sandbags at the shelter! Breakers in the wire, we're falling back inside!
lines.speaker: SGT. TOLLIVER / COLONY MILITIA
lines.synthesisText: [shouting, desperate] They're over the sandbags at the shelter! Breakers in the wire, we're falling back inside!

lines.text: The shelter has fallen. Get whoever is left to the lift.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [flat, grim] The shelter has fallen. Get whoever is left to the lift.

lines.text: They're over the sandbags at post two! Breakers in the wire, we're falling back inside!
lines.speaker: SGT. TOLLIVER / COLONY MILITIA
lines.synthesisText: [shouting, desperate] They're over the sandbags at post two! Breakers in the wire, we're falling back inside!

lines.text: We have lost post two. Nobody is coming out of there.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [flat, grim] We have lost post two. Nobody is coming out of there.

lines.text: They're over the sandbags at post three! Breakers in the wire, we're falling back inside!
lines.speaker: SGT. TOLLIVER / COLONY MILITIA
lines.synthesisText: [shouting, desperate] They're over the sandbags at post three! Breakers in the wire, we're falling back inside!

lines.text: We have lost post three. Nobody is coming out of there.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [flat, grim] We have lost post three. Nobody is coming out of there.

lines.text: They're over the sandbags at post four! Breakers in the wire, we're falling back inside!
lines.speaker: SGT. TOLLIVER / COLONY MILITIA
lines.synthesisText: [shouting, desperate] They're over the sandbags at post four! Breakers in the wire, we're falling back inside!

lines.text: We have lost post four. Nobody is coming out of there.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [flat, grim] We have lost post four. Nobody is coming out of there.

lines.text: Large contact, far side of the colony. That is no ordinary bore. That is the heart of the bloom.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [low, alarmed] Large contact, far side of the colony. That is no ordinary bore. That is the heart of the bloom.

lines.text: The mother bore has opened into a maw. Everything it has is coming up now.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [grim, urgent] The mother bore has opened into a maw. Everything it has is coming up now.

lines.text: Mother bore is collapsed. The swarm just lost its heart.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [firm, relieved] Mother bore is collapsed. The swarm just lost its heart.

lines.text: Matriarch on the surface. Mechs, heavy weapons or satchels, nothing else will stop it.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [grave] Matriarch on the surface. Mechs, heavy weapons or satchels, nothing else will stop it.

lines.text: They're taking the fallen. The grabbers drag the bodies down the holes. Don't let them have anyone else.
lines.speaker: SGT. TOLLIVER / COLONY MILITIA
lines.synthesisText: [horrified, low] They're taking the fallen. The grabbers drag the bodies down the holes. Don't let them have anyone else.

lines.text: Tender is grounded and building. Give it ground to work on.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [even, confident] Tender is grounded and building. Give it ground to work on.

lines.text: First hardpoint is up at the lift. We can hold here with fewer hands.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [satisfied] First hardpoint is up at the lift. We can hold here with fewer hands.

lines.text: Pickup craft is on its way down to the lift. It will wait for us.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [clipped] Pickup craft is on its way down to the lift. It will wait for us.

lines.text: Pickup is down at the lift and holding. Bring the survivors to it.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [even] Pickup is down at the lift and holding. Bring the survivors to it.

lines.text: That is everyone aboard. Thank you. We will remember what the company did here.
lines.speaker: ADMINISTRATOR VOSS / COLONY SHELTER
lines.synthesisText: [breaking, grateful] That is everyone aboard. Thank you. We will remember what the company did here.

lines.text: We have lost the survivors. Pull the company back to the ships.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [flat, heavy] We have lost the survivors. Pull the company back to the ships.
